auto_vacuum=NONE (SQLite's default and the recipe's): the file never shrinks on its own; PRAGMA incremental_vacuum does nothing
auto_vacuum=FULL: the DELETE's own commit moves pages and truncates the file, leaving no freelist
auto_vacuum=INCREMENTAL: freed pages wait on the freelist until PRAGMA incremental_vacuum truncates the file
